title: 'Buff a friendly unit' gives no target choice
expected: pending-choice.ts:624-660 (choose-mode resolution) calls `executeEffect(picked, effectCtx)` directly on the picked option's effect without raising a choose-target prompt (the choose-target prompt in chain/resolve.ts:141-244 only inspects the top-level effect.target / sequence lead, and a `choice` effect has neither). handle_buff (abilities/effects/buff.ts:22) -> getTargetIds -> resolveTarget, which for a non-"all" quantity returns `filtered.slice(0, 1)` (target-resolver.ts:312-313), i.e. the first friendly unit on board (Aphelios). If that unit is already buffed, buff.ts:29-33 `continue`s, so nothing happens and Skulker is never offered. Matches observed behavior.
observed: Picking mode 2 resolved immediately with no choose-target pendingChoice; first time it auto-buffed Aphelios, second time (Aphelios already buffed) nothing changed and Skulker was never offered/buffed.
